answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 36718 Country: India Title: My name is Faiyaz Pathan. Is my name Faiyaz right or wrong Question: My name is Faiyaz Pathan. Is my name Faiyaz right or wrong? Answer ID: 36718 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 338/338/M=1433) Faiyaz name is correct. It means: generous, beneficent. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
